desc: Derive cost formula: cost(l,r) = Σ prefix_max - Σ nums; verified against examples.
Design right expansion: monotonic deque of (value, count) blocks; push pops smaller values, accumulates counts, updates S.
Design left contraction: decrement front block count, subtract its value from S, popleft when count hits 0.
Implement the full two-pointer solution cleanly: push right with delta-tracked S update, shrink left while S - W > k, accumulate ans += r - l + 1.
Verify against both provided examples plus edge cases: n=1, strictly increasing array, strictly decreasing array with k=0, large values (all pass, plus 2000 randomized brute-force cross-checks).
